## Critique
- claim-1: Bibliographic identity, retrieval URL, and hash are supplied. However, the cited lines establish title and authors, not the asserted arXiv version or DOI; those rely on provider metadata.
- claim-2: Correctly and exactly grounded.
- claim-3: The three equations are correctly located. In particular, lines 790–798 are also the statement of the actual Theorem 4.4.
- claim-4: Substantially correct, but the exact hypothesis is that the syzygy’s **left-hand side is nonzero**, not merely that the syzygy is nonzero.
- claim-5: Incorrect. Lines 667–705 occur before Section 4 begins at line 737, so they cannot be Proposition 4.4 and Lemma 4.5. Under the source’s shared section counter, Definition 4.1 begins at lines 738–741, Lemmas 4.2 and 4.3 at lines 743–748 and 777–784, Theorem 4.4 at lines 790–818, and Theorem 4.5 at lines 819–826. Thus the claimed source discrepancy is false.
- Requested target: **not established by the specialist output**. The actual Theorem 4.5 was omitted and replaced by an unrelated Section 3 lemma.

## Repair certificates
- [source-refresh] From the same native archive at `https://export.arxiv.org/src/2209.02011`, SHA-256 `267a2f5eeae54137af99793e84d5293ec688e854ffff662ddd3a27b1334e2bbd`, extract and cite the Section 4 counter sequence and the actual Theorems 4.4–4.5: [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 737-748], [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 777-818], and [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 819-826].

## Required revisions
- Retract claim-5 and the assertion that items 4.4–4.5 are not theorems.
- State Theorem 4.4 as the inconsistency result at lines 790–818.
- State Theorem 4.5 as the no-syzygy result at lines 819–826.
- Revise the target status to established only after those actual theorem excerpts are included.
